caption: The drawing depicts a room with striped green wallpaper and floral border trim, featuring a wooden floor partly covered by a rectangular, patterned rug in shades of blue, red, and green. In the center of the room is an ornate dental chair with red upholstery, metal frames, and attached platforms. Multiple mechanical devices and dental instruments, including foot pedals, tubes, gears, and various metallic and glass components, are arranged around and attached to the chair. On the left side, there is a wooden cabinet and shelving unit holding books, glass containers, and small items, as well as a mounted metal basin. On the right side, an ornately carved wooden table holds more mechanical dental equipment, including a gas canister and other vessels connected by tubes. A three-armed brass chandelier with three white lampshades hangs from the ceiling. White lace curtains, drawn to the side, cover the back window. Additional items in the room include a small wooden stool, wall shelves with books and jars, an owl model or figure on a wall-mounted perch, and a framed poster showing a woman in a white dress sitting atop a model of giant teeth, with the word “SCIENTIFIC” above her. The composition is symmetrical, focusing on the dental chair as the central element, surrounded by various dental tools and equipment positioned with intentional placement across the room. The color palette includes greens, browns, reds, blues, and brass tones.
title: Dentist's Operating Room
